source: New_Recording.m4a (take 1) — the 18.4s excerpt, chosen by his ear
why: His ear picked versions 2 and 5 of the five-way test, and both are built on this excerpt. The measured alternative — a 28.8s reference whose opening ten seconds score 0.982 against his real voice versus 0.951 for this one — lost. The proxy measured proximity to the recording; he was judging accent and naturalness, which it does not capture. Kept as reference-measured.wav rather than deleted.
construction: Chatterbox conditions on the reference's first 6-10 seconds, so the 10-second window scoring highest against his real voice opens the file; the rest is the next-highest utterances, for the speaker embedding.
